title: New Heavens and New Earth
definition: The New Heavens and New Earth are God’s promised restored creation where righteousness dwells and His people live with Him forever.
summary: The New Heavens and New Earth are God’s promised restored creation where righteousness dwells and His people live with Him forever.
christFocus: Jesus secures the new creation through His resurrection victory and reigns until all things are made new.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
New Heavens and New Earth places present life under the future God has promised. God’s future is embodied, holy, joyful, and free from curse.

Scripture teaches the last things to produce hope, holiness, endurance, and urgency rather than speculation. The suffering, disabled, grieving, and rejected need hope that restoration will be real, not imaginary.

Christ stands at the center of this future. Jesus secures the new creation through His resurrection victory and reigns until all things are made new. Because of Him, believers can face death, judgment, suffering, and the future with sober confidence rather than fear.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
The coming future exposes what truly matters now. The suffering, disabled, grieving, and rejected need hope that restoration will be real, not imaginary. Scripture’s teaching about the last things steadies the heart in a world that feels unfinished.

It also guards the Church from fear-based prophecy and careless delay. The Lord calls His people to watchfulness, holiness, comfort, mission, and trust.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Endure with hope and practice righteousness as a citizen of the coming world. Bring this doctrine into prayer, Scripture, and daily obedience. Ask the Holy Spirit to make the truth real in your thinking, desires, relationships, and next faithful step with Christ.
